user.title: Reef ICP
user.description: Create the aquarium first with its net water volume, stocking profile, dosing/supply system, independent reef/nutrient method and target-source mode. An ICP report is not required yet. After creation, the first or any later ICP analyses can be imported at any time through Configure.

analysis_date.title: Select analysis date
analysis_date.description: Reef ICP detected {provider}, but no trustworthy analysis date could be found in the report or filename. Select the date of this analysis.

confirm_provider.title: Confirm ICP provider

custom_targets.title: Personal aquarium target ranges
custom_targets.description: Set optional personal target ranges for salinity, alkalinity, calcium and magnesium. For each parameter, enter both minimum and maximum. Leave both fields empty to keep using the target from each ICP laboratory for that parameter. Laboratory target ranges and laboratory status remain preserved.

custom_supply_system.description: Enter the name of your dosing or supply system.

aquarium_settings.title: Aquarium settings
aquarium_settings.description: Set the aquarium's net water volume, stocking profile, permanent dosing/supply system, independent reef/nutrient method and target-source mode. The supply system and reef method are intentionally separate, so combinations such as Balling Light + ZEO LIGHT are possible.
